custom_fields.body:
[[[ const fridge = states['number.kole_fryseskab_refrigerator_temperature']; const freezer = states['number.kole_fryseskab_freezer_temperature']; const door = states['binary_sensor.kole_fryseskab_koleskabsdor']; const power = states['switch.kole_fryseskab_power']; const fridgeValue = fridge?.state && fridge.state !== 'unknown' && fridge.state !== 'unavailable' ? `${Number(fridge.state).toFixed(0)}°` : 'Ukendt'; const freezerValue = freezer?.state && freezer.state !== 'unknown' && freezer.state !== 'unavailable' ? `${Number(freezer.state).toFixed(0)}°` : 'Ukendt'; const doorOpen = door?.state === 'on'; const powerOn = power?.state === 'on'; return `
Køleskab
${powerOn ? 'Tændt' : 'Slukket'} · Dør ${doorOpen ? 'åben' : 'lukket'}
Køl
${fridgeValue}
Frys
${freezerValue}
`; ]]]
